objective: Exercise QuantumTransportEOM through its public open-system API against analytic and conservation identities.
claim: QuantumTransportEOM v0.4.0.dev0 reproduces the resonant-level Lorentzian, equilibrium FDT and zero current, and steady-state current conservation.
assumptions: The tested devices are noninteracting and use wide-band lead self-energies.
The supplied energy grids resolve the resonances and truncate negligible spectral tails.
limitations: This case validates a high-value open-system slice, not every symbolic, interacting, parallel or GPU path.
The case is local because the current development package is not a released ASTRUM artifact.
